decisions.statement: Every spelling asked after is searched for in one run.
A spelling is matched as written letters rather than as a pattern.
The file kinds searched are the ones the caller names.
The git folder and the packages folder and the index folder are left unsearched.
A path the search names is answered against the root that search was handed.
A caller handing a root rather than a world is answered every path the search names.
A file the repository ignores is left unsearched where the caller names no kind.
A file a named kind matches is searched though the repository ignores that file.
A folder the repository ignores is left unsearched whatever kinds are named.
A body no commit holds yet is searched though the repository ignores it.
A path the answer so far writes is answered beside the paths the search names.
A path the answer so far writes is answered though no body sits on disk.
A path the answer so far takes away is left out though the search names it.
A path the answer so far moves is answered at the path moved to.
A search that named nothing and ended badly throws.
A search naming paths is answered with those paths though that search ended badly.
A call asking after no spelling searches nothing.
A listing names every path the tree holds rather than the paths a spelling is in.
A listing runs the same program under the same rules a search runs under.
Every file kind is listed, and a caller wanting one kind reads it off the path.
A listing is answered in path order.
How many threads a search or a listing takes is the caller's to say.
A caller saying nothing is answered as fast as the machine allows.
A caller held to a processor ceiling says one thread, spending less of what it is held to.
A listing names no kind, and a file the repository ignores is left unlisted.
A listing narrowed to kinds leaves out a file the repository ignores all the same.
A kind is named to such a listing as a type rather than as a glob.
A glob would take precedence over what the repository ignores, and a type does not.
A listing narrowed to no kind lists nothing rather than everything.
No index is read to say which paths are there.
Which spelling a body holds is not said.
The program that searches is not looked for on the path.

definition: the paths a search or a listing of the tree names, with the answer a change carries laid over
